name: Santander
verdict: Owned by Banco Santander, S.A., the Spanish-listed banking group whose Portuguese bank Banco Santander Totta trades as Santander Portugal. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of Los Gallos (Spain) (sailgp.com team page, fetched 2026-09-25). Front-of-shirt sponsor of Portugal's national rugby teams (renewed for three years, ECO, 2024-11-08).
